verdict: M1874 correctly repairs every exact M1871 attack and preserves the immutable B4/LRU4 datapath and evidence boundaries, but the checker still accepts nine independently designed structural-semantic bypasses. Both arithmetic scoreboards can be neutralized, all default SVA can be permanently disabled, response/bridge/commit backpressure properties can be made vacuous, and a time-zero forged PASS plus finish can be inserted. M1876 is not authorized and no source may be executed.

findings.title: The repaired checker still permits arithmetic, SVA, backpressure, and completion-causality bypasses
findings.evidence: On both CPython 3.6 and 3.12, the independent probe preserved all M1874 searched vocabulary and exact repaired M1871 snippets while applying nine new structural-semantic attacks. validate_tb_text accepted independent neutralization of each baseline and TSBG Acc24 scoreboard and accepted a time-zero forged PASS token followed by $finish. validate_sva_text accepted a permanently true default disable and vacuous bank-response, bridge-header, bridge-payload, commit-header, and commit-payload backpressure antecedents. Two positive controls changing BUNDLE=4 and the candidate hit ledger were rejected, so the probe exercised the intended validators rather than bypassing import or dispatch.
findings.risk: A reviewed successor could pass the current static gate while proving neither typed-signed Acc24 correctness nor stable request/response/bridge/commit behavior, or could terminate with a forged PASS before workload, replay, reset, and ledger checks. Exact SHA sealing freezes such a source but does not establish that the semantic checker rejects it before sealing.
findings.required_fix: Create a new additive immutable source/checker/test successor. Require unique causal PASS placement after the final protocol ledger; exact non-vacuous baseline and TSBG arithmetic scoreboard structures; reset-only default disable; and non-vacuous exact response, bridge, and commit stability properties. Add all nine M1875 attacks to dual-interpreter regression, then obtain a new different-author zero-P0/P1 source hammer. A separate independently reviewed campaign source and launch release are still required after any source PASS.

required_next_gate: Additive source/checker/test successor covering all nine M1875 attacks, then a new different-author fail-closed source hammer with P0=0 and P1=0. Even after a source PASS, author a separate independently reviewed campaign source and launch release; M1876 may not be used as a naked execution release.
